version_note: 1.1.0 adds the U-TRANSPORT unpublished topic and 23 plain-speech phrases to R-ICT-HELPDESK, both added after the evaluation sets were frozen and both written in response to observed failures. The frozen cases were not edited. See eval/CHANGELOG.md.
provenance_policy: Every row records the public URL it was compiled from and a verification status, and the status is shown to the user rather than hidden. 'published' means the institution publishes this destination on at least one of its own properties. 'published_conflicting' means the institution publishes two or more different values for the same function, which is disclosed to the user rather than silently resolved. 'derived' means the destination was compiled by cross-referencing published routes and no single page states it, so it is shown with that caveat. An unconfirmed destination is never included as a row at all: an unverifiable email address is worse than an absent one, because the user has no way to tell the difference.

verification_legend.published: Confirmed on at least one institutional property.
verification_legend.published_conflicting: Confirmed, but the institution publishes conflicting values elsewhere. Both are shown.
verification_legend.derived: Compiled by cross-referencing published routes; no single page states it.

routes.label: Admissions landing page — start here
routes.summary: Start here if you are not sure which application route you need. This page lists undergraduate, postgraduate and certificate applications.
routes.notes: Use this as the default admissions destination when the applicant has not yet chosen undergraduate, postgraduate, or certificates.

routes.label: Undergraduate application portal
routes.summary: The undergraduate application is submitted online through this portal, and the same portal is where you sign in to continue or check status.
routes.notes: The application is submitted online through this portal. No paper application route is published. Two phone numbers are published for this function, and both are shown to the user rather than one being presented as canonical.

routes.label: Postgraduate application portal
routes.summary: Postgraduate applications are submitted online here, for Master's and Doctoral programmes.
routes.notes: The admission landing page states the portal covers Master's and Doctoral programmes.

routes.label: Check application or admission status
routes.summary: Sign in to check whether an application has been submitted, is still in progress, or has an outcome.
keywords: my name is on the list
routes.notes: The assistant cannot read any applicant's status. It explains where to check and how to sign in.

routes.label: Certificate programmes (14 courses)
routes.summary: Fourteen professional certificate programmes across business, technology and AI, finance and law, and specialised areas.
routes.notes: Duration and tuition for individual certificates are not published.

routes.label: AI certificate programmes
routes.summary: Six of the fourteen certificates are specifically about artificial intelligence, from AI for finance and law to AI applications in robotics.
routes.notes: Six of the fourteen certificates are explicitly AI programmes: CUCAI, CUCIC, CUCIF, CUCAIB, CUCAIL, CUCAR.

routes.label: Tuition and payment questions — contact Admissions
routes.summary: The University does not publish tuition amounts on any page that can be read reliably, so this is the office to ask for a figure.
routes.notes: CRITICAL. No fee figure is published on any page readable at audit time. This route exists so the assistant can be useful without inventing an amount. It must state that the figure is not published and route to Admissions.

routes.label: Undergraduate admissions email (published conflict)

routes.notes: The contact-us page labels admissions@cosmopolitan.edu.ng as 'Undergraduate Admissions'. The admission portal publishes admission@cosmopolitan.edu.ng for the same function. Both must be shown with the conflict explained.
